title: The Exact Time-Uniform Rate Frontier for Stochastic Gradient Descent on Smooth Convex Objectives
summary: We study the time-uniform convergence of the raw iterate of standard stochastic gradient descent (SGD) for unconstrained smooth convex objectives. We prove that, under standard noise assumptions, the time-uniform convergence rate gets arbitrarily close to $\sqrt{\log n / n}$ but never reaches it.
